item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Tinubu reversed the core macro package or abandoned fiscal/monetary discipline.\nI also did not find proof that the reforms had already delivered durable, broad-based prosperity by the end of 2024.\nThe negative side is mostly outcome-based: inflation, food insecurity, and short-term hardship, plus some transparency concerns.","evidence":[{"title":"Nigeria: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; Staff Report; Staff Statement; and Statement by the Executive Director for Nigeria","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/05/08/nigeria-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-staff-statement-and-548726","summary":"IMF said the administration advanced fuel-subsidy removal, unified FX windows, set up a fiscal/tax reform committee, and used palliatives to soften the shock.
